page_title: REN 3-0 LYO | Rennes v Lyon 18/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Benoit Millot has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
90+4' Rennes control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90+1' 3 - 0 Henrik Meister (Rennes) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.
90+1' The ball goes out of play. Lyon are awarded a corner kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lyon comes to nothing.
87' Julien Stephan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Henrik Meister (Rennes) replacing Albert Gronbaek.
87' Here comes a substitution. Adrien Truffert (Rennes) is brought on as a substitute for Alidu Seidu.
86' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nemanja Matic.
85' The game has come to an end for Abner. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon).
85' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon) replaces Maxence Caqueret.
83' The ball is out of play and Rennes manage to earn a corner.
83' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benjamin Bourigeaud trots off the pitch and is replaced by Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes).
80' The corner is swung in but Lyon can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
80' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Lyon get a corner.
79' Post! Leo Ostigard (Rennes) pounces on the rebound inside the penalty box and tries to prod home! He's unlucky as the ball only rattles the left post.
79' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Rennes.
78' Rennes try to maintain the tempo of the game by taking a quick free kick.
77' Rennes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
76' The referee signals a substitution. Mama Balde (Lyon) is brought on as a substitute for Ernest Nuamah.
73' We are about to witness a subsitution. Hans Hateboer (Rennes) for Lorenz Assignon.
72' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it well wide of the right post.
71' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
71' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom left corner, but Steve Mandanda pulls off a superb save.
70' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Lyon are about to take a penalty!
70' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Lucas Perri easily deals with the threat.
69' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Lucas Perri is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
68' It will be a substitution. Malick Fofana (Lyon) is ready to enter the pitch as Orel Mangala walks off.
66' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
66' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
65' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Rennes.
64' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) is booked.
62' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.

62' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
60' Lyon quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
59' Said Benrahma (Lyon) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Lyon have a corner.
58' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
56' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
56' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
55' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) takes the corner with a short pass.
53' Rennes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
51' The resulting set piece from Lyon is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
49' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
48' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
48' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Rennes is cautioned for aggressive play.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Benoit Millot has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' The foul by Amine Gouiri (Rennes) was seen by Benoit Millot who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
42' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Leo Ostigard (Rennes) for his blatant foul.
40' Lyon hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
37' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
37' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Benoit Millot signals.
33' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
33' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
32' Said Benrahma (Lyon) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
31' One of the Lyon players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
29' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.
24' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Lucas Perri easily deals with the threat.
23' Said Benrahma (Lyon) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
21' 2 - 0 GOAL! Amine Gouiri (Rennes) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 2:0.
19' 1 - 0 Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Lucas Perri. 1:0.
18' A free kick on the edge of the box for Rennes. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
17' PENALTY APPEAL by Rennes, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
16' Good clearance! Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
12' The resulting corner from Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is cleared.

11' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball goes out of play. Lyon are awarded a corner kick.
11' Leo Ostigard (Rennes) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
8' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
7' Glen Kamara (Rennes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
7' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lyon was in an offside position.
4' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) is penalised for holding. Benoit Millot signals a set piece.
3' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) runs into space on the edge of the box and tries a curler that drifts well wide of the left post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Rennes will have the kick-off.
Benoit Millot got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
